claims.evidence: photo 0 front plate shows 'Nikon' and 'D610' text
photo 2 shows two separate battery packs laid out with the body
photo 2 shows a small prime lens but no readable focal length or brand markings; cannot confirm it is a 50mm
no 85mm lens appears in any of the 3 photos

claims.claim: Camera is functional (implied by live menu screen)
claims.evidence: photo 1 shows the menu lit and navigable, which only proves the screen and basic menu system work, not shutter, sensor, autofocus, or mirror function

risks.risk: Shutter actuation count unknown on a body this old; D610s are known for high shutter-count units and a shutter-replacement history (some D600/D610 units had sensor dust/oil-spot issues)
risks.proof: Screenshot of shutter count from a menu/app (e.g. via a shutter-count checking tool or EXIF of a fresh photo)
risks.if_unproven: priced as high-mileage/unknown shutter life, i.e. at the low end for a used D610 body

risks.risk: Sensor condition (dust, oil spots, scratches) cannot be judged from exterior photos
risks.proof: A photo of a test shot against a plain white/blue sky at narrow aperture (f/16-f/22) showing the full frame
risks.if_unproven: priced as having unknown/potential sensor issues

risks.risk: Actual shutter/autofocus/metering function not demonstrated (only menu screen shown)
risks.proof: A short video clip of the camera firing the shutter, autofocusing, and displaying a live-view image
risks.if_unproven: priced as not confirmed working, i.e. worst case as non-functional until shown

risks.risk: Lens identity and condition (claimed 50mm) not confirmed; could be a cheaper or different focal length, and optical condition (fungus, scratches, haze) is unknown
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the lens barrel showing brand/model/focal-length text, plus a photo through the front and rear elements against light
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic/unverified kit lens rather than a confirmed 50mm prime

risks.risk: Battery health/cycle count unknown; batteries could be degraded or third-party with short life
risks.proof: Photo of battery info screen (menu showing battery charge/life indicator) for each battery
risks.if_unproven: priced as batteries of unknown/degraded capacity

risks.risk: No charger, memory card, strap, or original box shown; these affect bundle value
risks.proof: Photo of charger, strap, and any included accessories together with the camera
risks.if_unproven: priced as body+lens+batteries only, no accessories included

risks.risk: 85mm lens claim cannot be assessed at all since it is not shown
risks.proof: Photo of the actual 85mm lens with visible brand/model text
risks.if_unproven: excluded from pricing entirely until shown; cannot be priced as an add-on

proof_requests: Video clip of the camera powering on, firing the shutter, and autofocusing with a lens attached
Shutter count screenshot or EXIF data from a fresh test shot
Clear close-up photo of the 50mm lens barrel showing brand and focal length markings
Test photo shot at narrow aperture against a plain bright background to check sensor for dust/spots
Photo of the actual 85mm lens if it is to be considered part of the sale
Photo of charger and any other included accessories
response.reason: The body is clearly identifiable as a Nikon D610 with two batteries shown, and a lens is visible though unconfirmed as 50mm, so the core bundle can be priced at its worst-case (unverified function, unknown shutter count, unverified lens) while the 85mm lens cannot be priced since it is never shown in any photo.
